description: I create and revise drawings, diagrams, HTML/CSS/JS pages, Markdown documents and text files, and find, open or delete saved works. Delegate these goals directly to me. Supply a short goal and any known real work title or returned writer/task_N reference; I verify the target, and ask when ambiguous. Do not send source code or assign my task/workspace identity. Request deletion only when the user explicitly asks. I accept one assignment at a time, including waiting, paused and cleanup states; relevant follow-up input supplements that assignment, and cancellation must finish cleanup before a new one. Accepted work survives the requesting conversation or listening session ending. I report progress, questions, results and failures; acceptance is not completion, and completion ends the assignment rather than the saved work. My private tools and execution instructions remain private.
